units: Vanilla hull-space units (1 sprite px = 1 unit); multiply by metres_per_unit for metres

wear.note: Eight years in the belt, unpowered: heavy dust in every cavity, sun-faded paint, dense chips, cold old soot on all four drives, old dark scorch at every open strike.

effects.kit: second-wind-vfx (swfx.apply, groups thrusters, smoke, guns, lighting; no rig preset)
effects.controls: SWFX controls (animatable custom properties; see second-wind-vfx/README.md)

thrusters.note: RCS quad positions are art placement, not canon.

guns.reason: no gun anchors: the derelict hulk carries no guns (stripped)

effects.append: load both 'SECOND WIND | derelict' and 'SWFX' in one call; the ship alone works without it

conventions.root: Every ship part and anchor descends from the root; move, rotate or scale the root only.
conventions.anchors: Local +X is the effect axis (drive exhaust aft; gun line of fire); +Z as near hull-dorsal as that allows.
conventions.turrets: Rotate a Turret <i> pivot about its local Z to train; rest pose is the slot angle.
conventions.wear: Base wear: group `SW wear <state>` on skins and swatches (wear.py). State overlay: group `SW overlay <state>`, its `SW overlay master` value scales it (0 = base wear only).
conventions.metric: Hull units; multiply by metres_per_unit for metres. Nothing in the asset is in metres.
